text:
Nina: Quick thread to lock a super-compact "micro-deck" for the webinar: one hero line, three micro-charts, two CTAs. Keep it snackable for AB tests.

Aran: Love 'snackable'. My proposed hero: "Fast where it matters. Cheap where it counts." Subtitle: "Three visuals to show how config moves latency & $/1k."

Priya: Charts we need: 1) sparkline + tail inset (median/p95/p99) across models & deploy modes, 2) stacked opt waterfall for $/1k (model, infra, batching, quant, cache), 3) persona micro-grid (Startup/Scale/Enterprise) with p95 target and expected $/1k.

Mika: Visual ask: make the sparkline tiny (fits in header), put a bright accent on tail improvements, and show cache as a separate mini-sparkline per persona. Captions = 6-10 words.

ChartBot: Data schema required: model,deployment_mode,quant,seq_bucket,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_hit_rate,batch_profile. Will validate CSV.

Nina: Timeline: Priya hero + 2 alternates by Mon 11am. Aran raw CSV + sample prompts by Mon 4pm. Mika mockups Tue AM. I assemble Tue PM and send to ops Wed.

Aran: I'll upload to s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/1771239999-sparkline.csv by Mon 15:30 UTC. Includes cache/no-cache and batch_profile rows.

Priya: Hero alternates (ultra-short):
- A: "Promise speed. Measure savings."
- B: "Speed that scales. Economics that add up."
Prefer B for deck, A for social.

Mika: For the waterfall, annotate two knobs with tiny callouts: "batching: up to -40%" and "quant: up to -25%" (range is illustrative). Also include tiny note: "cache hits observed: 20-55% in our samples."

Aran: Quick reproducibility snippet for appendix (tiny):
```
# rough per-1k token cost
sec_per_1k = 0.81
gpu_rate = 2.7  # $/gpu-hour
cost = (sec_per_1k / 3600) * gpu_rate
print(cost)
```

ChartBot: Preview upload OK. Mean cache_hit_rate = 0.39. No schema errors.

Nina: CTAs for the 1-pager: 1) "Run your prompts  See your numbers" 2) "Request a Dedicated eval  Talk to solutions." For inbound routing tag leads as bench-sparkline-1771239999.

Priya: I'll drop hero + three 8-word captions in drive/marketing/sparkline-1771239999/ by Mon noon.

Mika: Will post mockups in thread once CSV validated. Expect 2 color variants.

Nina: Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag here. Final review Wed AM. :rocket:
